series_end_reason: Sumitomo Pharma prints ALVESCO on its own line in its North America segment table through the FY2014 results (ebr20150511_4.pdf: FY2014 38). From the FY2015 first-quarter release (ebr20150729_4.pdf) it prints one 'Ciclesonide' row defined by the footnote '* Total of 3 ciclesonide products (ALVESCO, OMNARIS, ZETONNA)', which is held as the continuation companion sepracor_alvesco_cont (2015Q2 to 2018Q1). AstraZeneca (rights to 2018) printed only a combined Alvesco/Omnaris/Zetonna figure in a press release and no Alvesco line in its product-sales tables; Covis Pharma (owner since 2018) is private.
notes: Series is the U.S. line printed by Sepracor, 2008Q3-2009Q3. The 2009Q1-2009Q3 values are printed zeros (the company states no revenue was recorded while launch-phase inventory was worked down), included so the series has no gap. 2008Q4 is negative ($(0.3) million) because of product returns. FY2008 total printed in the Sepracor 10-K (ALVESCO HFA Inhalation Aerosol 16,809 thousand) equals 17.1 less 0.3 within rounding. Ownership: Nycomed/Takeda owned the brand, Sepracor distributed it in the U.S.; Sunovion (Sepracor renamed) divested U.S. rights to Covis in 2017. Ownership: Sepracor reported 2008Q3-2009Q3 (the last quarter from the Sepracor Fact Book 2009); Sumitomo Pharma owned Sepracor from October 2009 and prints ALVESCO sales of its U.S. subsidiary Sunovion Pharmaceuticals in the supplementary data of its financial results from FY2011, so 2010Q1-2015Q1 are read from those files (2010 from prior-year columns, because Sumitomo's 2010 files do not break ALVESCO out); 2009Q4 is declared unreported. Sumitomo's table is headed 'North America segment (based on local currency)' in USD millions and is the U.S. subsidiary's product sales, so the scope is unchanged. Until the year ended March 2013 the subsidiary was consolidated on calendar-year statements (columns are calendar months); from FY2013 on its year ends March 31, so fiscal Q1 (Apr-Jun) = calendar Q2. Quarters derived from cumulative figures carry the rounding of USD 1 million inputs. Checks against printed totals: 2010 rows 7+6+8+8 = 29 (printed Jan-Dec 2010: 29), 2011 rows sum to 35 (printed 35), 2012 to 38 (printed 38), FY2013 11+11+11+9 = 42 (printed 42), FY2014 9+10+11+8 = 38 (printed 38). The earlier statement that Sumitomo's reports do not itemise ALVESCO applied to its Fact Books and to its FY2009-FY2010 files, not to the supplementary data of FY2011 onward.
search_log: Listed Sepracor (CIK 877357) filings via data.sec.gov submissions: 8-K Item 2.02 and 10-Q/10-K 2007-07 to 2009-08; fetched every EX-99.1 earnings release (2007-07 to 2009-07) and grep'd for ALVESCO; sales appear first in the 2008-10-28 release (Q3 2008, launched September 2008). The 2008-07-29 release says launch is planned for fall 2008, so no sales before 2008Q3.

Q3 2008 from the 10-Q (0001047469-08-011809) MD&A: 'Sales of ALVESCO HFA Inhalation Aerosol were $17.1 million and $0 for the three months ended September 30, 2008 and 2007'; the 10-K (0001047469-09-001949) product table prints ALVESCO HFA Inhalation Aerosol 16,809 for 2008; the Q4 2008 release prints $(0.3) million for Q4 and $16.8 million for September-December 2008.

Q1 and Q2 2009 10-Qs print sales of $0; no Q3 2009 10-Q was located because Sepracor was acquired in October 2009; the Q3 2009 figure comes from the Sepracor Fact Book on the Sumitomo Pharma IR site (Product Revenue - Alvesco 0 / 17,100).

Checked Sumitomo Pharma fact books fb201006 to fb201712_rev2 (pdftotext): ALVESCO appears only in pipeline/launch-history text, with no sales; AstraZeneca 6-K results 2017-02 to 2019-02 (8 releases) contain no Alvesco line in product tables, only divestment text; AstraZeneca's 2018-11-06 press release gives a combined 2017 figure for Alvesco, Omnaris and Zetonna ($106 million), not usable for Alvesco alone.
Covis Pharma (owner from 2018) is private and publishes no sales figure; Takeda/Nycomed ex-U.S. rights were not found in Takeda product tables (not exhaustively searched).
Bigdata.com smart searches returned no documents for this product; EDGAR and company IR sites were used directly.

Refresh pass: every Sumitomo Pharma financial-results supplementary file (sumitomo-pharma.com/ir/library/financial_results_summary/, ebr*.pdf, 155 files from 2006 to 2026) downloaded and text-searched for ALVESCO. A row 'ALVESCO (ciclesonide)' with USD figures appears in the 'Sales of Products in the North America Segment' tables from ebr20110511_4.pdf to ebr20150511_4.pdf; ebr20130509_4.pdf also prints ALVESCO 8 in the Sunovion January-March 2013 sales table; from ebr20150729_4.pdf the row is 'Ciclesonide *' (total of three products); from ebr20170511.2.pdf it is 'Ciclesonide'; no ciclesonide row in ebr20180727.2.pdf or later.

2010 quarters: Sumitomo's 2010 files carry no ALVESCO row, so Jan-Mar 2010 (7) is the prior-year column of ebr20110511_4.pdf, Jan-Jun 2010 (13) of ebr20111031_4.pdf and Jan-Sep 2010 (21) and Jan-Dec 2010 (29) of ebr20120203_4.pdf; the quarters are differences of those cumulative figures.
FY2009 files (ebr20100203_4.pdf, ebr20100510_4.pdf) and FY2010 files (ebr20100730_4.pdf, ebr20101029_4.pdf, ebr20110203_4.pdf): ALVESCO only in pipeline tables, no sales; hence 2009Q4 is unreported.

unreported_quarters.2009Q4: Ownership change Sepracor to Sumitomo Pharma (Sepracor became an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Dainippon Sumitomo Pharma on October 20, 2009, Form 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/877357/000110465909059627/a09-31878_18k.htm); Sepracor filed no Form 10-K or 10-Q after the Form 10-Q for June 30, 2009 and the Sepracor Fact Book 2009 stops at the quarter ended September 30, 2009. Sumitomo Pharma's FY2009 supplementary data (ebr20100203_4.pdf, ebr20100510_4.pdf) print no ALVESCO sales figure: ALVESCO appears there only in pipeline tables, and the Sunovion Jan-Mar 2010 sales table lists LUNESTA, XOPENEX, BROVANA, OMNARIS and 'Others'. The first figures Sumitomo prints for ALVESCO are in its FY2011 releases (ebr20110511_4.pdf), with 2010 as the prior-year column.
